title: Why the food-scrap bin is wet

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I changed two things about the kitchen bin this week. It still smells when I lift the lid, but there's no puddle at the bottom now.
turns.zh: 這星期我對廚房的廚餘桶做了兩個改動。掀蓋時還是會聞到味道，但桶底現在沒有積水了。
turns.role: household member who changed the bin

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Which change stopped the puddle? I thought you'd opened the vents in the lid.
turns.zh: 是哪個改動讓積水消失的？我以為你把蓋上的通風孔打開了。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I didn't open them until today. The bottom's been dry since I started lining it with plain paper on Monday. Today the paper is already damp, though the bottom underneath it is dry.
turns.zh: 通風孔是今天才打開的。我從星期一開始在桶底墊一般的紙，之後桶底就沒積水。今天紙已經潮了，但紙下面的桶底仍是乾的。
turns.role: household member who changed the bin

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then the paper is catching the liquid. Let's keep using it. We don't know yet whether the vents help with the smell. We should check that separately before we change anything else.
turns.zh: 那就是紙把液體吸住了。我們先繼續墊紙。還不知道通風孔能不能改善味道，改別的東西前要把這點分開測。
